panels.description: Sanitizer-compatible navigation bus with native keyboard focus. Primary bus 0–4: Trust / Overview / Pipeline Diagnostics / Provider Health / Data Quality. Adjunct 5–6: Incident Workspace / Run Explorer. Current workspace is a non-interactive chip (aria-disabled + data-current=page, underlined) so active state is not color-only. Handoffs open same-tab, preserve current time range, and document scope reset or context mapping on cross-scope transitions. Chip colors are theme-safe for dark and light.

panels.title: Understand Run Scope

options.content:
Which exact run should be inspected?
Scope: BROWSE = recent runs · SELECTED RUN = identity/accounting · FULL PATHS = report artifacts, not triage bodies
Fail-closed: pipeline=unknown and run_id=- show no runs — not a missing store and not a healthy run.
Run coverage: Coverage uses selected-run timestamps via Review Run Summary (covers_selected_run). This banner is not a coverage verdict. Do not treat CURRENT Prometheus as that UUID.
Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser

panels.description: Run Explorer has two modes. Browse mode lists recent run-report artifacts for the selected pipeline. Selected-run mode uses BioETL Ops HTTP to show identity, accounting, reasons, reconciliation, and artifacts for one exact run. Fail-closed empty state: default pipeline=unknown and run_id=- intentionally show no runs (not a missing data store and not a healthy run). Select a real pipeline from the dropdown (e.g. chembl_assay, chembl_activity), keep run_type compatible (often backfill), then pick a concrete run_id (not -). Expand Selected Run Details for the last-20 browser and full identity/accounting. Run ID is never a Prometheus label. Full filesystem paths belong to report-artifact Open/Copy actions, not scan-oriented cells.

panels.title: Inspect Recent Runs (last 4)
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Browse mode: latest four pipeline-run reports found on disk for the selected pipeline. $pipeline is a pipeline name (chembl_assay, chembl_target, chembl_publication), not a workflow (chembl_baseline). Workflow artifacts live under reports/run-reports/workflow/<name>/ and GET /ops/observability/workflow-run-reports. Choose a row to set the run ID and open exact-run evidence. An empty table is valid when no matching reports exist for this pipeline (index_state=valid_empty). A TREE_MISSING / LAYOUT_UNHEALTHY / IDENTITY_UNHEALTHY row is bind or origin failure, not a selector problem — run python scripts/ops/runtime/docker/verify_report_bind.py from the checkout you are viewing. If reports are expected and the table is empty without that row, treat backend unavailable as a distinct failure and verify BioETL Ops HTTP at /health/live. Has reports: chembl_assay, chembl_target, chembl_publication. chembl_activity may appear in run_id (control-plane) but has no report artifacts yet. First screen is bounded to the last 4 artifacts (limit=4). The complete last-20 browser is in Selected Run Details. Older runs are omitted by design; they are not a missing backend.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — no pipeline-run-report artifacts for the selected pipeline under reports/run-reports/pipeline/<name>/ (first screen is last 4).

panels.title: Inspect Run Identity
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Selected run: compact 4-row identity summary (run, manifest, provider.entity, identity health). Selection required when no run ID is set. Valid empty means no matching identity was found for that run. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR; verify /health/live. Full identity rows remain in Selected Run Details. Use existing Open/Copy actions for full values.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run first. VALID EMPTY if the selected run has no identity.

panels.title: Inspect Processed Records
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Selected run: compact four-row stage summary (bronze total, silver valid, gold written, gold quarantined). Zero-valued outcomes are evidence and must not be presented as success by themselves. Selection required when no run ID is set. Valid empty means no matching accounting rows exist; unexpected empty or errors require an Ops HTTP /health/live check. Full accounting remains in Selected Run Details.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — selected run has no accounting rows. Select a Run ID first; backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

panels.title: Inspect Recent Runs (last 20)
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Complete last-20 pipeline-run-report browser. First-screen Inspect Recent Runs stays at limit=4. An empty table is valid when no matching reports exist (index_state=valid_empty). TREE_MISSING / LAYOUT_UNHEALTHY / IDENTITY_UNHEALTHY is bind or origin failure. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR and is distinct from valid empty.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — no pipeline-run-report artifacts for the selected pipeline under reports/run-reports/pipeline/<name>/ (index is last 20).

panels.title: Inspect Full Run Identity
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Complete identity rows for the selected run. First-screen Inspect Run Identity is the four-row summary. Selection required when no run ID is set. VALID EMPTY means the selected run has no identity; backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run first. VALID EMPTY if the selected run has no identity.

panels.title: Inspect Full Processed Records
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Complete Bronze/Silver/Gold accounting. First-screen Inspect Processed Records is the four-row summary. Zero-valued outcomes remain evidence.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — selected run has no accounting rows. Select a Run ID first; backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

panels.title: Inspect Stage Funnel
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Selected run: Stage counts from pipeline_run_report_v1 for the selected run. This is a stage funnel, not start/end chronology. Selection required when no run ID is set. Valid empty means the report has no stage rows; unexpected empty or errors require an Ops HTTP /health/live check.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — selected run report has no stage funnel rows. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

panels.title: Inspect Top Run Reasons
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Selected run: Top removal and outcome reason codes recorded in pipeline_run_report_v1 for the selected run. Selection required when no run ID is set. Valid empty means the run recorded no reason rows; unexpected empty or errors require an Ops HTTP /health/live check.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — selected run report has no reason rows. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

panels.title: Inspect Reconciliation
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected run: Record-accounting reconciliation evidence from pipeline_run_report_v1 for the selected run. Selection required when no run ID is set. Valid empty means reconciliation evidence was not recorded. Review Processed Records and the raw report before escalation; verify /health/live for unexpected empty or errors.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — selected run report has no reconciliation rows. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

panels.title: Inspect Layer Accounting
panels.description: Selected run: Exact layer counts come from pipeline_run_report_v1.layers; Processed Records provides the compact stage/outcome view. Selection required when no run ID is set. Use the JSON or Markdown report and review reconciliation before escalating an accounting mismatch.

options.content: Layer accounting: exact layer counts come from pipeline_run_report_v1.layers; use Inspect Processed Records for the compact stage/outcome view. Selection required without a run ID. Review reconciliation before escalating an accounting mismatch.

panels.title: Inspect Run Artifacts
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Selected run: Artifact references recorded in pipeline_run_report_v1 for the selected run. Scan-oriented cells keep paths short; use Open/Copy actions for the full location. Selection required when no run ID is set. Valid empty means no artifacts were recorded; verify /health/live for unexpected empty or errors.

defaults.noValue: VALID EMPTY — selected run report has no artifact rows. Backend failure renders as QUERY ERROR.

panels.title: Inspect Timings & Failure
panels.description: Selected run: Optional stage-timing and failure evidence recorded for the selected run. Empty means the report did not record these optional blocks—not zero duration and not proof of success. Selection required when no run ID is set. Open the JSON or Markdown report for exact details.

options.content: Timings & failure: optional blocks on pipeline_run_report_v1. Empty means not recorded — not zero duration and not proof of success. Open the JSON or Markdown report for exact details.

panels.title: Continue Run Investigation

options.content: Continue Run Investigation — 1) Pick a recent run · 2) Verify Run Identity and Processed Records · 3) Expand Selected Run Details · 4) Open Trust for recovery/replay safety. Run Explorer is evidence-only.

panels.description: Choose a recent run in Browse mode, verify Run Identity and Processed Records in Selected run mode, expand the stage/reason/reconciliation/artifact details, then open Trust to review recovery or replay safety. Run Explorer is evidence-only and does not execute resume or replay actions.
